description: Client-side script for managing Landed Cost Voucher in ERPNext, including setup, refresh, and charge distribution logic.

classes.name: LandedCostVoucher
classes.description: Class extending StockController to handle Landed Cost Voucher operations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes query filters and fetches for purchase receipts.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Displays help content and sets currency labels based on company.

methods.name: get_items_from_purchase_receipts
methods.description: Fetches items from purchase receipts if available.

methods.name: amount
methods.description: Recalculates total taxes and charges and applies charges to items.

methods.name: set_total_taxes_and_charges
methods.description: Calculates and sets total taxes and charges.

methods.name: set_applicable_charges_for_item
methods.description: Distributes charges proportionally among items based on selected criteria.

methods.name: distribute_charges_based_on
methods.description: Triggers re-distribution of charges based on user selection.

methods.name: items_remove
methods.description: Handles removal of items and updates applicable charges.
